document_ownership.PROJECT_ROADMAP.md: What will be built and in what order.

document_ownership.docs/adr/: Why durable architecture decisions were made.
document_ownership.docs/journal/: What happened, what was learned and what comes next.

rules: Do not duplicate detailed commands from the guide in tasks.json.
Codex must not invent architecture decisions that have not been agreed.
Record actual implementation evidence, not intended work.
An ADR is required only for a durable decision with meaningful alternatives or consequences.
A session is not complete until verification, documentation and the commit boundary are satisfied.
